newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: South Seas scales down capital increase.
newsitem.headline: South Seas scales down capital increase.

text.p: Oil explorer South Seas Natural Resources Inc said on Wednesday its board of directors had revised plans to double its capital stock to 400 million pesos and decided to raise it to 250 million pesos instead.
Corporate Secretary Manuel Antonio did not tell the Philippine Stock Exchange why the firm decided to reduce the capital increase.
Antonio said the board had also set a one-for-four rights issue to partly cover the capital increase.
